entry.title: [NEW] GHSA-cpvr-w4j5-2mpg: Librsvg: Use-after-free when XML includes have duplicated entities
entry.content:
Librsvg: Use-after-free when XML includes have duplicated entities

Aliases: CVE-2026-96889, RUSTSEC-2026-0305

Severity: CVSS_V3: CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H

Affected:

  • librsvg — fixed in 2.57.5
  • librsvg — fixed in 2.60.3
  • librsvg — fixed in 2.61.5
  • librsvg — fixed in 2.62.4
  • librsvg — fixed in 2.63.2

Librsvg uses libxml2, a C library, to parse XML. When librsvg parses an SVG document which has a nested Xinclude, an XML entity declaration with a duplicate name as an existing one can cause a use-after-free error. While libxml2 is expanding an internal entity, a recursive XInclude can parse another document that declares an entity with the same name. Both parses use the same `XmlState` entity map on the librsvg side. `entity_insert()` replaces the first entry, whose `Drop` implementation calls `xmlFreeNode()`. The outer `xmlCtxtParseEntity()` then keeps using the freed 144-byte `xmlEntity`. The included parse should not free an entity that the outer parser is still using. The fix is in commit 8a1b0cd319e9af2d1e9cf878081dd77f227a0504, where librsvg will no longer free xmlEntity pointer…

entry.title: [NEW] GHSA-9jh8-v38h-cvhr: ammonia: mXSS via MathML `annotation-xml` encoding strip
entry.content:
ammonia: mXSS via MathML `annotation-xml` encoding strip

Aliases: CVE-2026-63430, RUSTSEC-2026-0193

Severity: CVSS_V4: CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:P/PR:N/UI:N/VC:N/VI:N/VA:N/SC:L/SI:L/SA:N

Affected:

  • ammonia — fixed in 3.3.2
  • ammonia — fixed in 4.0.2
  • ammonia — fixed in 4.1.3

If a certain set of MathML tags are enabled, an attacker can inject arbitrary JavaScript code into the user's browser. The `annotation-xml` tag has slightly different behavior than the other "integration point" tags in MathML and SVG, but ammonia didn't handle it, so it didn't correctly strip the namespace-incompatible tags. This vulnerability only has an effect when the `math` and `annotation-xml` tags are both enabled, but the `encoding` attribute is disabled, because it relies on the following sequence of steps: 1. User writes code like `<math><annotation-xml encoding="text/html"><gadget></annotation-xml></math>`. 2. Namespace filtering checks the DOM, and it passes. `<gadget>` is parsed as HTML. 3. Attribute filter strips it down to `<math><annotation-xml><gadget></annotation-xml></…

entry.title: [NEW] RUSTSEC-2026-0384: Race condition in `tokio::time::Interval` on Tokio v1.54.0
entry.content:
Race condition in `tokio::time::Interval` on Tokio v1.54.0

Aliases: GHSA-5wjr-9356-4wc8

Affected:

  • tokio — fixed in 1.54.1

## Summary On the multi-threaded runtime, there is a race condition between `Interval::poll_tick` and the runtime's time driver. This affects `Interval` only. `Sleep` and `Timeout` are **not** affected. ## Details In Tokio v1.54.0, a race condition between `tokio::time::Interval::poll_tick` (including `.tick().await`) and the runtime time driver can drop an internal timer entry without synchronizing with the driver thread that is firing it. This causes a data race and use-after-free on the timer's waker and task state in safe Rust, leading to assertion panics, task reference-count corruption, or heap memory corruption. This bug was introduced by https://github.com/tokio-rs/tokio/pull/8458, and it was fixed by https://github.com/tokio-rs/tokio/pull/8692. ## Impact This may lead to cr…

entry.title: [NEW] GHSA-26w4-8w32-4x3v: Slack Morphism verifier errors disclose valid HMACs in the logs
entry.content:
Slack Morphism verifier errors disclose valid HMACs in the logs

Aliases: CVE-2026-113799

Severity: CVSS_V3: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:H/A:N

Affected:

  • slack-morphism — fixed in 2.28.0

### Summary Slack Morphism exposes the correct Slack request HMAC when signature verification fails. For an invalid request, `slack-morphism` computes the correct signature for the attacker-controlled timestamp and request body and stores it in `SlackEventWrongSignatureError.generated_hash`. The error's `Debug` and `Display` representations expose that value, and the default Axum listener error handler logs it at error level. An attacker who can both reach the application's Slack callback endpoint and read its application/service logs can therefore use the verifier as a chosen-message HMAC oracle. The attacker can send an arbitrary request with an invalid signature, recover the correct signature from the resulting log entry, and resend the same request within the five-minute freshness w…

entry.title: [UPDATED] GHSA-4gg8-gxpx-9rph: uv is vulnerable to arbitrary file write through entry point names
entry.content:
uv is vulnerable to arbitrary file write through entry point names

Aliases: CVE-2026-114109

Affected:

  • uv — fixed in 0.11.15
  • uv — fixed in 0.11.15

### Impact In versions of uv prior to 0.11.15, when installing a distribution containing an entry point specification (under `console_scripts` or `gui_scripts`), uv would place the generated entry point according to the given name even if doing so resulted in a path outside of the environment's scripts directory. A malicious wheel could use this to place an executable outside of the intended environment, including in a directory already present on the user's `PATH`. This could shadow or overwrite an existing executable and potentially result in unexpected code execution under the wheel's control, even if the wheel's installation environment was not explicitly added to `PATH` by the user. In order to exploit this vulnerability, the attacker must induce their target into installing a mali…

entry.title: [UPDATED] RUSTSEC-2026-0381: Bundled root certificates allow trust in distrusted emSign intermediates
entry.content:
Bundled root certificates allow trust in distrusted emSign intermediates

Aliases: CVE-2026-111943, GO-2026-6809, RUSTSEC-2026-0382, RUSTSEC-2026-0383

Affected:

  • webpki-roots — fixed in 0.26.11, 1.0.10

Affected versions include `emSign ECC Root CA - G3`, which can allow certificate paths through distrusted emSign intermediates. Affected versions may accept certificate paths containing distrusted emSign intermediate public keys. The private keys corresponding to these intermediates are now well known. Version 1.0.10+ removes this root. The `webpki-roots` 0.26.11 compatibility package contains no independent trust store and re-exports the roots from its separately resolved 1.x dependency. That parent dependency must resolve to 1.0.10 or newer; an older parent remains affected by this advisory.

References:

  • https://crates.io/crates/webpki-roots
  • https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0381.html

  • https://emudhra.we-have-a-problem.com/
  • https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2083449

Affected:

  • webpki-root-certs — fixed in 0.26.11, 1.0.10

Affected versions include `emSign ECC Root CA - G3`, which can allow certificate paths through distrusted emSign intermediates. Affected versions may accept certificate paths containing distrusted emSign intermediate public keys. The private keys corresponding to these intermediates are now well known. Version 1.0.10+ removes this root. Version 0.26.11 is a compatibility wrapper that re-exports `parent::TLS_SERVER_ROOT_CERTS` from its `webpki-root-certs` 1.x dependency; it contains no separate root certificate list. Its resolved 1.x dependency must be updated to 1.0.10 or later.

entry.title: [UPDATED] RUSTSEC-2026-0382: Certificate verification may accept distrusted intermediates
entry.content:
Certificate verification may accept distrusted intermediates

Affected:

  • rustls-webpki — fixed in 0.103.16, 0.104.0-alpha.8

Affected versions may accept certificate paths containing distrusted emSign intermediate public keys when the configured trust anchors allow such paths.
